descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S14 Counts at the edges: 0 tasks, 1 task, only completed tasks — screen and Copy Text

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 One consolidated in-app end-of-day view lists every open task across all of the physician's patients, each attributed to its patient (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U2 On the view the list is grouped by patient, pending tasks first and completed tasks at the bottom; every task shows which patient it belongs to (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U3 Copy Text copies the whole list (pending and completed) to the clipboard in the same grouping, every task under its patient; the copy stays on the device (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U10 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home (UAT TC-07; UAT 3.3; TFA-92585 AC 12) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • G3 UAT 3.4 applied to the list: the view, Copy Text and the sent list contain only stored tasks, patients and locations — no invented task, patient, room, 'undefined' or 'null' (UAT 3.4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Standard fixture with no tasks at the start

When Open Task Export and Copy Text with 0 tasks; add one task and open Task Export; tick it done and Copy Text again. Same in Nursing Home. The scripted step reads each clipboard

Then 0: no patient, no task, no 'undefined', the page is not blank, the copy has no patient. 1: the task under its patient. Only completed: nothing listed as pending, the task at the bottom with its patient, and the copy includes it as completed

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): U1–U3 and G3 (nothing invented). What Copy Text should hold when empty is Q9, so only the negatives are judged at 0, and 'not blank' is a human check (spec.manual, oracleRules 7). Only completed: the task is below the completed heading (['Finished Tasks', task], oracleRules 8), so 'nothing listed as pending' is decided. …

Where it ran: dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S14 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-07.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Test method: PW · Playwright script (PW (clipboard)) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
